items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Well he was one of the young drummers.

ctx.x: Do you remember any drummers, early drummers way back when you were a kid, you know, that would be out in the street that impressed you? That's being good?

Yeah. Yeah. They had a fellow, Rennell Jackson. Rennell Jackson? Yeah, he's from Thibodeau. Well he was one of the young drummers. And that time, and I mean I noticed so much, you know, but he died very young. What did he play?
